pro_course_detail.title: English for School Writing
pro_course_detail.description:
I am a native speaker with a midwestern American accent, and I have taught in grade schools, colleges and as an online tutor.

This lesson is for children in 6th through 12th grade who are fluent or almost fluent in English. It will be tailored to meet your child’s unique needs and interests, focusing on improving your child’s understanding of grammar and adding to their vocabulary. I do not intend to teach grammar or vocabulary until I know what they need. I will teach them how to write clearly and vividly as well as how to write strong arguments. In most cases, this will include teaching them logic (argumentation) and outline writing. If your child needs to work on their pronunciation, I can help with that, too.

I teach using my own resources and your child’s corrected work, as well as any writing they do for me. I develop my own Google docs resources to share with students to help them with grammar, vocabulary, etc., and I share those with students and parents via gmail. When your child has written something for a class or taken a grammar or vocabulary test and doesn’t understand what they got wrong, they can share those documents with me so that I can explain and teach them how to avoid mistakes.
  
If your child needs help with  pronunciation, they’ll read articles about topics they’re interested in or resources I’ve shared with them to me. As they make pronunciation mistakes, I’ll correct their pronunciation and give them exercises to complete as homework when needed to improve their pronunciation.

Please let me know if you have any questions about my teaching methods, and please consider having your children take a trial lesson with me to help you all get an idea of whether you think I would be a good fit. 

I look forward to meeting you!

pro_course_detail.title: English Writing for School and Business

This lesson is tailored to meet your unique needs and interests, focusing on academic and/or business vocabulary, syntax, grammar and clarity, as well as pronunciation if necessary.  It’s intended for people who are fluent or becoming fluent in English and want to improve their speaking, listening and writing skills for work or school.  I’ll help you perfect up to two written texts per week, and I’ll familiarize you with phrasal verbs, idioms and slang if you’re interested.  I can also help you practice for exams and interviews with common questions and useful techniques. I would also be happy to help you build your online presence in English for sites like LinkedIn.  

Depending on what you're writing, this may also include teaching logic and how logic is related to outline writing. 

I hope you’ll consider taking a trial lesson with me so you can consider whether I will be a good fit for you. I look forward to meeting you!

pro_course_detail.description:

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Writing Mock Test (OFFLINE)
pro_course_detail.description:

In this lesson, I will send you your choice of a Task 1 or Task 2 IELTS writing prompt that you must complete BEFORE the scheduled lesson time. I will give written corrections and feedback based on the IELTS public band descriptors on your writing document.

30 Minute lesson: One Task 1 /OR/ One Task 2 prompt
60 Minute lesson: Two Task 1 /OR/ Two Task 2 /OR/ One Task 1 & One Task 2

After booking, please message me which type of Task you would like, and whether you are taking the Academic or General Training IELTS test :)

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Development and Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you looking to enhance your conversational skills and gain confidence speaking English? My "Conversation Development and Practice" lessons are designed to help you achieve just that!

Fluency and Confidence: Engage in real-life conversations to improve your speaking fluency and boost your confidence in using English.

Pronunciation and Intonation: Fine-tune your pronunciation and intonation to sound more natural and be easily understood by native speakers.

Vocabulary Expansion: Learn and use new vocabulary in context, making it easier to remember and apply in everyday conversations.

Listening and Comprehension: Improve your listening skills to understand various accents and speaking styles.

Cultural Insights: Gain insights into cultural nuances and idiomatic expressions to make your conversations more authentic and engaging.

Let's start speaking English with confidence!

pro_course_detail.title: Cultural Immersion: American Culture
pro_course_detail.description:
Immerse yourself in the rich and diverse culture of the United States with my "Cultural Immersion: American Culture" lessons. This course is designed to give you a deeper understanding of American customs, traditions, and social norms while enhancing your language skills.

In this course, we'll explore:

Everyday Life: Discover the nuances of daily life in America, including common social practices, holidays, and traditions.

Language and Slang: Learn how Americans communicate, including popular slang, idiomatic expressions, and regional accents.

Cultural Etiquette: Understand the dos and don'ts of American culture to help you navigate social and professional situations with ease.

Pop Culture: Dive into American music, movies, TV shows, and literature to get a taste of what shapes contemporary American society.

History and Heritage: Explore significant historical events and figures that have influenced American culture and values.

Each lesson is interactive and tailored to your interests and goals, whether you're planning to visit, study, work, or simply want to deepen your cultural knowledge.

Join me for an engaging and informative journey into American culture. 

Let's make learning fun and enriching!

pro_course_detail.title: Guided English Lessons: Speaking, Reading, Writing and Listening
pro_course_detail.description:
Unlock your full potential in English with my "Guided English" lessons. This comprehensive course is designed to improve your reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills, giving you a well-rounded command of the language.

In this course, we'll cover:

Reading Comprehension: Enhance your ability to understand and analyze various texts, from articles to short stories, with tailored exercises and discussions.

Writing Skills: Develop your writing abilities through structured practice in different formats, including essays, emails, and creative writing, with personalized feedback.

Listening Practice: Improve your listening comprehension through engaging audio materials, including conversations, podcasts, and videos, to help you understand different accents and contexts.

Speaking Practice: Build your confidence and fluency in speaking English with interactive conversations, pronunciation practice, and real-life scenarios.

Each lesson is customized to meet your individual needs and goals, ensuring a personalized and effective learning experience. Whether you're preparing for exams, improving your professional skills, or simply aiming to become more proficient in English, this course is designed to help you succeed.

Join me for a dynamic and comprehensive learning journey that will elevate your English skills to the next level!
